name: Memory (NeatMem)
description: NeatMem memory backend for OpenClaw — local, controllable, mem0-compatible. Injects recalled memories into agent context (auto-recall) and extracts facts after each turn (auto-capture). Both configurable via autoRecall/autoCapture settings.

providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: For a local NeatMem server any token works, e.g. neatmem-local.

apiKey.label: NeatMem API Key
apiKey.help: Use a SecretRef ({"source":"env","provider":"default","id":"NEATMEM_API_KEY"}) or ${NEATMEM_API_KEY} instead of storing the key directly.

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically store conversation context after each agent turn

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories before each agent turn

customInstructions.label: Custom Instructions
customInstructions.placeholder: Only store user preferences and important facts...
customInstructions.help: Natural language rules for what NeatMem should store or exclude

customCategories.label: Custom Categories
customCategories.help: Map of category names to descriptions sent to the extraction model as hints. Sensible defaults are built in.

searchThreshold.label: Search Threshold
searchThreshold.help: Minimum similarity score for search results (0-1). Default: 0.1

topK.label: Top K Results
topK.help: Maximum number of memories to retrieve

recall.label: Recall Tuning
recall.help: Fine-tune recall/search behavior: threshold, rerank, keywordSearch, filterMemories.
